topic: Interior Light Function Allocation Specification for Z-ONE-3.0 Platform
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific function or signal related to interior lighting and door status, detailing its mode definitions, input sources, and associated controllers/modules.
column_semantics: The columns define the signal/function name, its possible values/modes, the input source (e.g., CAN, internal), the responsible controller/module (e.g., LHZCU), and additional system references like VS SSTS or门锁SSTS.

core_entities.name: UsrMdV
core_entities.description: User Mode Value for interior lighting, defining different operational modes such as Standby, Comfortable, Normal Driving, AI Parking, AIPilot, and XOTA.

core_entities.name: DrvrDoorOpenSts
core_entities.description: Driver's Door Open Status, indicating whether the front left door is closed, open, ajar, or fully open.

core_entities.name: RLDoorOpenSts
core_entities.description: Right Rear Door Open Status, similar to DrvrDoorOpenSts but for the right rear door.

core_entities.name: DrvrWlcmPedlLghtCtrlCmd
core_entities.description: Driver's Welcome Pedal Light Control Command, an output signal to control the welcome pedal light.

core_conditions.name: Input Source
core_conditions.description: Indicates where the signal/data originates, such as CAN bus, internal module, or other systems like VS SSTS.

core_conditions.name: Controller/Module
core_conditions.description: Specifies the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) or module responsible for processing or controlling the signal, e.g., LHZCU.

core_outputs.name: DrvrWlcmPedlLghtCtrlCmd
core_outputs.description: An output command sent to control the driver's welcome pedal light based on the defined logic.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the functional allocation and signal specifications for interior lighting modes and door status monitoring within the Z-ONE-3.0 platform. It is used to verify that the correct mode is activated based on user inputs and that door statuses are accurately reported to the relevant controllers.
uncertain_points: The exact behavior of DrvrDoorOpenSts when the latch switch cannot detect the door ajar status is not fully detailed.
The specific timing or sequence requirements for DrvrWlcmPedlLghtCtrlCmd are not provided in this table.
